title: Rational rank of an abelian group
statement: For an abelian group $G$, its rational rank is the cardinal-valued invariant $\operatorname{rrk}(G):=\dim_{\mathbf Q}(G\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathbf Q)$, where $\mathbf Q$ is the rational field [def-weil-field], $G\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathbf Q$ has its canonical $\mathbf Q$-vector-space structure, and $\dim_{\mathbf Q}$ means the cardinality of a Hamel basis (possibly infinite). Thus $\operatorname{rrk}(G)$ is the dimension of the rationalization of $G$ without a finite-dimensionality assumption.
